claims.note: Rescoped to the recorded request: the probe sent think:false natively and no thinking control to /v1, yet /v1 returned 394 reasoning characters in the stream and a reasoning field in the non-streamed message, with the wall times recorded in 00_summary.json. The endpoint-capability sentence cites s3, which documents reasoning_effort and reasoning.effort on that surface and maps "none" to false for boolean-only models; the article states that this run sent neither field and therefore tested neither. No claim is made that /v1 lacks thinking control.

presentation.title_rationale: Frontloads the product (Ollama) and the reader's exact problem (tool-call arguments differ by API surface) in one supported comparison; the 400 replay, version scope and measurement date move into the description and introduction.
presentation.visual_purpose: Shows the measured contrast that the article is about: the same call arrives as an object on /api/chat and a JSON string on /v1/chat/completions, and both cross-endpoint replays return HTTP 400 with their specific error text. Every value comes from the 2026-11-15 probe on Ollama 0.20.3 with qwen3:0.6b; no invented numbers or vendor claims.
